entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not bad. Your Persona's pretty powerful.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Y'mean that thing that comes outta you[n]guys all dramatic-like?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes. You saw how Frizzy Hair here ripped[n]off his mask when he summoned it, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, everybody wears a mask deep within[n]their heart. By removing that...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Huh? He turned back to normal...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, it looks like you don't have full[n]control over your power yet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The transformation shouldn't normally[n]dissolve like that. After all—

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Rrgh, that's enough! This crap doesn't[n]make any sense!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Can't you just sit still and listen for once,[n]Blondie!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Don't call me Blondie! My name's Ryuji...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Actually, there's no time for me to[n]lecture you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You wanna escape this place in one piece,[n]right? Let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, but before that—take these.[n]Use them carefully, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we should hurry. It's not much[n]farther to the exit.
